---

SCENE: The kitchen, evening
Copper pans, a stone floor.
ON SCREEN: Hartley (thinking)
HARTLEY: The cook was clear about one thing.
CLUE: dinner/c1: Doctor Birch did not have the rope.
CLUE: dinner/c2: Either the rope or the poison was in the kitchen.
CLUE: dinner/c3: Doctor Birch, Hartley noted, had been in the kitchen or out in the garden, never anywhere else.
---
SCENE: The garden, night
A wet garden with a stone bench.
ON SCREEN: Hartley (grim), Miss Cole (cool)
MISS COLE: I was in the kitchen, and I never touched the rope.
CLUE: dinner/c4: Miss Cole did not have the rope.
CLUE: dinner/c5: Miss Cole was in the kitchen.
HARTLEY: Then it is time to say who did it.
PUZZLE: dinner (murdle)
HARTLEY (satisfied): The case is closed. Almost.
